name: MD Preview
description: Preview local Markdown with an outline, file explorer, Mermaid diagrams and static HTML previews. All processing stays on-device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src file:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; worker-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none';
